propositions: Destructive repair operations (fsck and doctor) currently depend on GitHub CLI workflow disable/enable for safety and must be made provider-neutral using durable pause ref ownership.
Repair must acquire and validate ownership of a pause document before any destructive mutation, abort if pre-existing pause exists, and clear only its own pause by matching token and OID.
Both read_pause_with_oid (new) and read_pause (legacy) must coexist; the new function returns tuple of pause document and OID, the legacy function delegates and discards OID.

Repair sequence is fail-closed: missing git identity aborts before pause write, pre-existing pause aborts without clearing, pause creation uncertainty aborts, and lock held/corrupt/timeout aborts before mutation.
Cleanup must compare observed pause reason to invocation token and use the same observed OID for CAS delete; a miss or mismatch leaves pause intact for operator recovery without retry.
Both fsck and doctor repair must use identical provider-neutral pause contract without changing public vocabulary, existing repair effects, or non-repair behavior.
